assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The civic component passport, lease/test-first procurement flow, and maintenance handover are reference mechanisms for professional and public-sector teams to deepen.
assumptions.impact: No component specification, budget, supplier, contract, ownership or implementation commitment is implied by the proposal.

assumptions.statement: Accessibility, fire safety, electrical safety, drainage, data security, public-space permits and maintenance responsibilities must be verified before any component trial.
assumptions.impact: The geometry and figures show spatial relationships only; they do not authorise installation or public operation.
